title: Florida House, District 101
what_it_does: Represents District 101 (Part of Broward) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings.

candidates.name: Hillary Cassel
candidates.occupation: State representative; attorney (co-founder of an insurance-litigation law firm); former Broward prosecutor
candidates.background: Hillary Cassel is a Dania Beach attorney first elected to House District 101 as a Democrat in 2022; she switched to the Republican Party in December 2024, citing the Democratic Party's stance on Israel and its disconnect from everyday Floridians. She holds a law degree from Nova Southeastern University and previously worked as a prosecutor. She serves as vice chair of the House Insurance & Banking Subcommittee.

abortion.summary: Cassel voted against SB 300, the six-week abortion law, in 2023, and after switching parties said she remains pro-choice and does not support the six-week ban.

other_issues.title: Party switch and Israel
other_issues.summary: Announcing her switch to the GOP in December 2024, Cassel said she was troubled by the Democratic Party's failure to unequivocally support Israel and its tolerance of extreme progressive voices; she said she remains pro-choice and pro-LGBTQ rights and would focus on housing and property insurance.

candidates.name: Todd Delmay
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Small-business owner (travel and tourism); former executive director of SAVE, an LGBTQ civil-rights organization
candidates.background: Todd Delmay, 54, is a Hollywood small-business owner with 25 years in the travel and hospitality industry and the former executive director of SAVE, Florida's oldest LGBTQ civil-rights group. He ran for the seat in 2022, narrowly losing the Democratic primary to Cassel, and served on Hollywood's Sustainability Advisory Committee.

abortion.summary: Delmay says reproductive decisions belong to patients and providers and would oppose bans and barriers; his campaign says he will never compromise on protecting abortion access.
